description: Prepare to work an issue: check/create your fork and a branch named from the issue title (learning the repo's branch convention from recent PRs when detectable), and write a local PREP.md checklist (verdict, gates, DCO reminders, next commands). Never clones. DRY RUN BY DEFAULT: no fork or branch is created unless execute is true; creating them requires GITHUB_TOKEN.

execute.description: Actually create the fork/branch. Defaults to false: dry run returns the plan only.

issue_url.description: Full GitHub issue URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123

name: prep_issue
